pages.text: The Gathering island sits in the lake near the RiverClan shore. Cross the fallen tree that reaches out to it, and keep your claws in. You do not want to swim!
pages.title: The Island

pages.text: Follow the stream between ThunderClan and WindClan up into the rocky hills. At its head lies the $(l)Moonpool$(): a stone hollow where a waterfall spills into a shining pool. $(br2)Medicine cats go there to share dreams with us. Walk softly, and follow the paw-worn path down.
pages.title: The Moonpool

pages.text: Any cat may come to the Moonpool by night, Clan cat or loner. Lie down at the water, and one of us will come to you: a cat you knew, if any of your Clan walks with us now. $(br2)We will give you a sign, the way to a place your paws have not found. We speak to each cat once a moon.
pages.title: Dreams
